verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS creative platform like Pika, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any privacy or opt-out control. The items cover creative features, pricing, sign-in methods and the developer API, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
